You'll never reach Season 20,
let alone complete it.

notes.title: 50% Off + Major Updates + Season 17 (free)! Holey Moley!
notes.content:
Endlight is 50% off. Truly that's all you need to know but if not... after 78 years we've finally released [b]SEASON 17[/b] (free)! 41 new mind blowing levels, and 5 new snags: Cloudbursts, Portals, Popcorn, Sponges, and Growths. What's a snag? Even I don't know.

[previewyoutube=QXsqAUMoJf8;full][/previewyoutube] 
[b]We've ALSO improved EVERYTHING[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Early, simpler levels are 40% faster. [/b]
Turns out the less chaotic early levels lacked the feeling of speed. A speed payers need. The speed increase did not make the levels harder. How is that possible? Because we manually adjusted those 250 early, simpler levels to make them easier - an arduous process that aged me greatly. Bonus: Some levels are now 5 times faster and impossible!

[*][b]Invincibility no longer chaotic.[/b]
Players asked for the invincibility effects to be toned down and... they were so right! Being able to see where you're going while invincible is amazing, and we regret the initial "more chaos!" design decision. Tragically, this change made all the levels much easier. Manually adjusting ALL 600+ levels to make them harder (including the 250 I just made easier) nearly killed me.

[*][b]The Greatest Moment[/b]
When player has no shields, and is shrinking away to nothing - if they get a hoop on the brink of death - it gives them FULL SHIELDS. Switching from near death to all powerful, suddenly turning the tables on all who doubted you,  is the greatest moment in videogame history. Fight me.

[*][b]Player state much clearer[/b]
Ship can be invincible (one hoop), double invincible (two hoops in a row), and shrinking to nothing (no hoops). With all the chaos, it was hard to see which state the ship was in. Now it's very clear - especially important when dealing with fire. You don't know what fire is? I envy you.

[*][b]No Bullshit Deaths[/b]
On some levels, it was occasionally impossible to see the deadly, huge "background" cubes. Players would collide with them (instant death) and wonder what happened. Fixed! On those levels, when players collide with the huge cubes, they simply disappear. All the feeling, none of the bullshit. Even knowing this, I still dodge those huge cubes.

[*][b]Snappier[/b]
Episodes start and restart much faster with less choppiness. We also tweaked vertex counts and draw distance on many episodes to ensure better performance with little visual loss. Plus many tiny performance improvements across the board. 

[*][b]Episode Improvements[/b]
Given all the changes, I was forced to QA all 600+ episodes once again. I removed anything that newly irritated me, made episodes more visually distinct, and added improvements that 2025 Jim had learned. Luckily most players have only completed Season 1!

[*][b]Infected Hoops Onslaught[/b]
Infected hoops now appear in massive waves. It's very dangerous and very thrilling. You don't know what infected hoops are? I envy you.

[*][b]Catching the Endlight[/b]
When you're outside, catching the Endlight instantly completes the episode even if you have no hoops. We added new and overlapping visual effects, and reduced collider size to ensure this was earned and not accidental. Catching the Endlight is truly the second greatest moment in videogame history. Fight me.

[*][b]Season 17 Motivation[/b]
Season 17, 18, 19 and 20 are absolutely brilliant - but you can't start with them. You need the 16 Seasons of prep. We've added a ton of motivational messages to keep you going. We want everyone to reach Season 17 (and thanks to the Unstuck Guarantee, everyone will).

[*][b]Miscellaneous[/b]
Right To Replay 2025 is now perfectly balanced - half the players will complete it this year! Achievements screen looks much better. More text, funnier text! Seasons 18, 19 and 20 (the final season) are ALREADY included in this update - so there will be no delays in releasing them. Endlight itself has a much improved pulsing effect - especially outside. The worst story in videogame history has been completed, finish Season 20 to read the entire thing - it's a work of art.

[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
You never noticed the bugs we fixed, so who cares!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/dfb2dcd795f3da84e098fa437dbb6d6208b33430.gif[/img]

[b]50% OFF!!![/b]
An absolute steal that hurts us but helps you so it's a WIN WIN!
We've never gone lower, nor do we plan to. Don't make us.

[b]Season 11 (March) just RELEASED![/b]
[b]Season 12 (April) just RELEASED![/b]
[b]Season 13 (May) just RELEASED![/b]
[b]Season 14 (June) just RELEASED![/b] 
Break out the potatoes and turn them into fries!

and I've only created trailers for 11 and 12 so far.
But... they're [b]amazing[/b]!

Season 13 is the start of "[b]The Sour Seasons[/b]",
They betray everything Endlight stands for.
Fire kills you, Rubber stops you. Sometimes they work together.
You'll initially hate them.
Eventually you'll hate them more.
Years later, looking back, you'll hate yourself for not hating them even more.

notes.title: 13 - Endlight FINALLY RELEASES Friday July 28, 2023!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/3fcdea0de01c1d2b7588311c3f6a7bbf1bf222ee.gif[/img]

[b]You knew this day would come.[/b]
But this isn't about you.
It's about [url=https://twitter.com/misterbigpants/status/1667352202967494662]Friday July 28, 2023[/url].
The day Endlight, after several false starts, [b]finally[/b] releases.
You're incredibly self centered.

I think we all know you're going to buy Endlight.
Proof: You're reading this.
The problem isn't you.
The problem is all of your friends who don't know about Endlight,
and are upset with you for not telling them.

[hr][/hr][b]What's new? Only EVERYTHING[/b]
Forget the Endlight you knew and loved, it's dead.
It's been replaced by Endlight.
[list]
[*]Real time lighting - check out those annoying GIFs!
[*]Volumetric fog
[*]Optimized for SteamDeck (it's SWEET)
[*]16 FREE DLC Seasons (400+ levels)
[*]Improved post-processing colour (LUTs)
[*]Improved framerate, somehow still 60fps+ in 4K (120fps+ at 1080p)
[*]Improved collisions
[*]More particles, plus more particles, and some more particles
[*]More user controlled configurations
[*]Extra spectacular Outside levels
[*]Redesigned the "Yearly Challenge", now titled "Earn The Right To Replay"
[/list]
This is great news for you! But for me... [b]FOR ME[/b] it means redoing the video and screenshots for both the Steam page and the website. The trailer also needs to be recreated, but since it confused people perhaps god is telling me something.

"What about the demo? Do you need to build a new one?"
Yes and No.
Yes I need to build a new one.
No because I removed it.


[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/d3b9353ca33b20e592bacd3f55b33c117dad782c.gif[/img]

[b]Anything else? Only EVERYTHING[/b]

[b]Steam Keys[/b]
You want one? I've got 400 for people who can spread the word.
aka. reviewers, press, streamers, influencers, people of great moral fibre 
Are you that people? E-mail jim@bigpants.ca before we e-mail you
(and you know we'll find you). Note: No natzis.

[b]Day Of The Devs - 10th Anniversary[/b]
After years of submitting, in Nov. 2022 Endlight made the DOTD cut (and that version had no real time lighting!). On Nov. 5 2022 DOTD displayed Endlight at the San Francisco midway! A day before flying out I got sick and couldn't attend. They wouldn't cancel my hotel, but they did give me a credit. So looks like I'll be visiting the midway this year to ... I'm not sure.

[b]Tik Tok[/b]
Last year, in a desperate effort to reach the kids, [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@misterbigpants]I created 30 hilarious TikTok videos[/url].
I consider the experiment a success.
If you don't find them hilarious, don't worry ....
I only did most of the work on Endlight.

[b]Steam Deck[/b]
Did I mention we optimized Endlight for the Steam deck? It's a lovely device. I was shocked at how user friendly it is, and how good Endlight looked and played on the small screen. Tiny Endlight is a different experience, yet somehow still awesome. I tip my hat to those Steam goofballs. Worth noting we've created a native Linux build for Steam Deck. Proton is for [b]fools[/b].

[b]Amazing Let's Play[/b]
ZeroFrameGaming plays the now-outdated Endlight demo and it's my [b]FAVOURITE[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-y_a9P6A6gI

[b]Real Time Lighting and Volumetric Fog Learnings[/b]
After a lot of work to enable these, It turns out that some Endlight levels look TERRIBLE with real time lighting and volumetric fog. So we needed to let each level decide whether to turn them on or off. Dynamically swapping between Endlight's original ultra-optimized shaders and Unity's PBR surface shaders was hard,  but ensuring the two sets of shaders produced the same overall look (lighting, lit textures, colouring, bloom) was even harder. And we're charging what, 15 bucks?!

[b]Hidden Machine[/b]
Hidden Machine says [url=https://twitter.com/MachineHidden/status/1667522074296950786]"You need to check this game out!"[/url]
finalspiral replies "looks cool"

[b]Post Processing Colour[/b]
Endlight's secret has always been post processed colour via look-up textures (LUTs). Last year we bought [url=https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/vfx/shaders/fullscreen-camera-effects/amplify-lut-pack-50070]200 more[/url], tweaked them, and sprinkled them liberally across the levels. If you like your dish without salt, Endlight is not for you.

[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/e4ef300bfab5a5440cded3f7bb0dce697a9a81bf.gif[/img]
Remember when you said we'd never make it?
You're looking pretty stupid right now.
I wish I was a mirror so you could see the look on your beautiful face.

[b]WASN'T ENDLIGHT SUPPOSED TO RELEASE JULY 2022[/b]
Wasn't it Miyamoto who said, "a great game never releases."

notes.title: 08 - Working Hard in 2022!
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay in posting, but rest assured we are WORKING HARD on finishing Endlight. [b]IT'S SO GOOD! [/b] The demo has produced much feedback (thanks everyone!), and we've almost finished addressing [b]every single concern[/b]. If it's something we can fix, [b]WE WILL FIX[/b]. The Steam demo will be updated shortly, so you can see our hard earned fruits. Endlight will release April 2022 (this time likely for REALZ!)

... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... 
[b]Configuration Menu[/b]
You Steamies LOVE to tweak knobs, so we have provided [b]MANY[/b]! Some examples:
[list][*] Performance: Draw Distance, Level of Detail, Threads, etc.
[*] Motion Sickness: FOV, Camera Rotation, Screenshake, Less/More Particles, Reduce Flashing, etc.
[*] Difficulty: Easy/Normal/Hard, Game Speed, Hoop Probability, etc.[/list]
These can be adjusted at a macro or micro level. Use our presets, then tweak until you find your own private Idaho. You can turn off anything that annoys you or gives you headaches. Additionally, we've tried to make Endlight as accessible as possible (hopefully we've succeeded). I'm also happy to report that the mouse is now properly supported (inside and outside, sensitivity settings). Checkout this fun thread about building the configuration menu:
https://twitter.com/misterbigpants/status/1482418815048814593

[b]All Options[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/b45a4dd4c7d26a77eec0335f9245b49ff9fb2552.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/c8fde93bf6610a6f9ad722db6bb5b8526b4137c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/0c965d1817bca9907760b46d9357fbb6b05c4805.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/9818faaaeadd10090a66acf26592ea84feebf6ae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/2abcffc3142b9caf6fc9fd0cf7ddd71e9762a09b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/35c7d27387c8d6c5ad397668e3a4adec1f9520e1.jpg[/img]

Note: Some players find Endlight too easy (!?). Increase the speed, lower the max shields, and decrease hoop probability - [b]problem solved[/b] yet [b]still fun[/b].

... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... 
[b]EGX 2021 - The LeftField Collection[/b]
https://twitter.com/misterbigpants/status/1451251534679977987
Endlight was chosen for the EGX 2021 LeftField Collection! LeftField is a the "ultra-indie" area of EGX (previously named Eurogamer Expo) - a GIANT videogame expo open to the public. CovId prevented us from attending, so Endlight was on its own. It faired well!

Finger Guns
https://fingerguns.net/games/2021/10/16/egx-2021-12-exciting-indie-games-to-keep-your-eye-on/
"When I first added Endlight to this list, I wasn’t sure I’d ever have the words to describe it. It’s a shifting, chaotic kaleidoscope of shapes and sound that I believe you experience rather than simply play"

LaurakBuzz
https://twitter.com/LaurakBuzz/status/1446069765467000832
"A music rhythm game about flying through rings, with RIDICULOUS numbers of obstacles to dodge."

Endlight, ya did good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/05bb525e91df879a846cde0cd12a13bb31383d48.gif[/img]


... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... 
[b]DarkZeroTV Gets Sick[/b]
https://youtu.be/3RHITYxr3iM?t=443
"i actually feel sick now, i feel ... just sick"
"that was special, in the worst way possible"
[b]OH MY GOODNESS! [/b] We can't have that!
Now that you can adjust the chaos, we hope DarkZeroTV can play.
Turn down for what? Turn down for DarkZeroTV.
Fact: I actually prefer playing Endlight with the chaos turned down. VERY unexpected.


... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... 
[b]Endlight Fails IGF - AGAIN![/b]
We have submitted Endlight to IGF NINE times in NINE years.
Each time we have completely failed, not even an honourable mention.
IGF 2022 was the latest attempt, and once again they were not impressed by all the cubes.
Our plan? Add MORE cubes and submit to IGF 2023! That should do it.
On the plus side, this twitter rabbit hole keeps growing:
https://twitter.com/misterbigpants/status/1479513565845504002


... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... 
Thanks for reading and [b]KEEP THE FAITH![/b]
